messages.author: acb2ff650a985928
messages.subject: Installing Rglpk
parts:
I'm trying:

sudo su - -c "R -e \"install.packages('Rglpk', repos='http://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Rglpk_0.5-1.tar.gz')\""

But receiving back:

install.packages('Rglpk', repos='http://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Rglpk_0.5-1.tar.gz')
Installing package into ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library’
(as ‘lib’ is unspecified)
Warning: unable to access index for repository http://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Rglpk_0.5-1.tar.gz/src/contrib
Warning message:
package ‘Rglpk’ is not available (for R version 3.0.1) 

I've read this is a RStudio issue?

Thank you!!

messages.author: acb2ff650a985928
messages.subject: Re: Installing Rglpk
parts:

install.packages("Rglpk", repos="http://cran.us.r-project.org")
